results.rule_text: Continuous employment required within past 12 months
results.impact: Disproportionately eliminates qualified re-entry talent without measuring actual capability.
results.recommended_intervention: Eliminate continuity as a mandatory gate; evaluate cumulative years and recent problem-solving.

results.rule_text: Most recent title must exactly match target vacancy
results.impact: Excludes adjacent career-transition candidates with strong transferable skill overlap.
results.recommended_intervention: Implement skill-vector adjacency matching across related functional roles.

results.rule_text: Mandatory certification dated within last 24 months
results.impact: Imposes a credential tax on candidates, although research found generic upskilling certificates did not raise callbacks.
results.recommended_intervention: Replace recency criteria with focused practical capability verification assessments.
